text_en: What? You were already here?
Meh... I knew that.
But how could you think I was dead? I thought we were buddies.
It's not good leaving a captain to fend for himself, and less so if he's as charming as I am.
Look, if you want me to give you this, you'll need to entertain me, and I'm not easy to entertain.
What do you need to do? Isn't it obvious? You know they call me the fastest captain in Zarga.
You're gonna have to beat my record in &.
Plus, if you manage to do it, I'll give you one of my spawn lances. A masterpiece of engineering!
Whaddya say? Do you have what it takes to beat the great Euder?
Can you hear me?!
Remember, you need to go round the entire circuit in less than & minutes!
Yee-haw! That was surprising, even to me! I am literally speechless.
Alright, get your breath back and we'll return to the city for your reward.
Well, well... Don't worry, not everyone has the guts for this. I'm sure you're good at other things, like... walking without falling over, for example.
Should we try again?
Soldier, you've raced amazingly, but I've thought about it a little harder... I'm not going to give you my spawn lances.
Seeing you run has lit the fire within me.
If you want one of my lance, you'll need to beat me in a head-to-head race.
Irka needs to shake his fear of running after that fall. I can't think of a better excuse than competing against you.
Whaddya say?
Even though Irka's injured, he's still the fastest horse in Zarga, so don't let your confidence get the better of you and give it your all.
Let's go!
But... how?
No one can run that much. You've tricked me!
Alriiiight... I didn't say anything about Irka using his wings, so...
You're a resourceful soldier, aren't you? Alright, let's head back to the city.
This time without cheating.
What did you expect? Irka is a winged horse.
You've still got a way to go before you can beat that. Or do you wanna bite the dust again?
Congratulations! Luckily there was no one nearby to see my performance. You're the fastest.
A promise is a promise. Use them to beat one of those monsters and see what happens. Who needs magic when you can invent things like this?
The Human mind is the real magic.
